notes.title: Park Ranger Demo | Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157216/7fa0d0052a6dd63d1f28faa7a6889cc66e84cb7f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a small update to the Park Ranger demo![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced shading for a more vibrant and colorful look[/p][/*][*][p]Improved driving physics for a smoother, more realistic feel[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We'll keep you up-to-date on all the updates we implement for the demo and thank you for being part of the journey! 💚 [/p]
